name: Dice
notes: Operated as a DHI service (parent DHI; country not stated). Pricing page lists a Single Job Slot at $399 with the job slot active for 30 days, Starter at $549 to $649 per month, and Standard at $749 to $899 per month, with monthly or annual billing. Pricing is valid for new customers only. Developer page returned no content on fetch. No language options or API mention found on pages read. Wikipedia: "In 2005, Dice Inc. was acquired by Dice Holdings, Inc."
